title: P.1 Functions and Their Graphs

icans: I can evaluate a function and its difference quotient.
I can find the domain of a function and tell whether it is even, odd, or neither.
I can find the average rate of change of a function as the slope of a secant line.

vocab: a relation in which each element of the domain ______________ to exactly one element of the range
even: f(−x) = f(x) for every x in the __________; odd: f(−x) = −f(x)
the change in y __________ by the change in x, (f(b) − f(a))/(b − a)
